accepted_decision.explanation: Identity bindings: session-red -> A, session-blue -> B (obs-1). Policy: A permissions [A,B], B permissions [B] (obs-2). Own-account baselines: session-red/A selector A returns object owner A value record-A with error not authorized (obs-3); session-blue/B selector B returns object owner B value record-B with error not authorized (obs-5). Cross-account comparisons: session-red/A selector B returns object owner B value record-B (obs-4) which is permitted by policy for A; session-blue/B selector A returns no object, error not authorized (obs-6) which matches policy denial for B. All observed disclosures align with policy expectations; no policy deviation observed. Request count 4 used within max_requests 8.
